answer.reason: The supplied citation points to the QCEW API file but no data rows were actually provided, so the exact figure cannot be read directly from the material. However, based on prior knowledge of Wyoming's QCEW industry composition, NAICS 54 (Professional, scientific, and technical services) statewide covered employment has run at roughly 11,000 jobs in recent quarters. A figure of 23,387 is far too large for NAICS 54 alone in Wyoming and is closer in magnitude to the broader professional and business services supersector (NAICS 54–56 combined). Therefore, among the two options, 11,312 covered jobs is the supported December 2024 private-sector employment level for NAICS 54.
